[42850 Natural Language Processing Algorithms | Subject description]
Credit points: 6

Natural Language Processing (NLP) develops AI algorithms and methods to enable machines to understand and interpret human languages. This subject provides a foundation in NLP technologies, explores advanced algorithms, and applies them to real-world problems. You'll gain both the knowledge to engage with NLP theories and the practical skills to craft NLP projects, bridging the gap between theoretical insights and hands-on application.

[42850 Natural Language Processing Algorithms | Learning and teaching activities]
This subject includes combined workshop and laboratory sessions (2 hours) with research and development work for the assignments. The workshop/laboratory sessions will have both individual and group activities, covering NLP theories and algorithms, hands-on exercise on NLP tools, and the understanding and interpretation of NLP project results.

Students are encouraged to engage in pre-reading materials, which will be made available on Canvas, and come with prepared questions for the workshops. During the workshop activities, students will receive feedback from the teaching staff and their student peers in a collaborative and discursive learning context.

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[42850 Natural Language Processing Algorithms | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Identify NLP applications in business and social contexts. (B.1)
SLO2: Reflect on their own NLP skill development. (F.1)
SLO3: Explain the advantages and disadvantages of different NLP methods and algorithms and their applicability in different business situations. (D.1)
SLO4: Design and implement solutions for real-world NLP problems. (C.1)
SLO5: Interpret the results of an NLP project. (E.1)
